artifacts.summary: Six-phase plan correlating both uncorrelated .postflight-pending marker selection sites to the stopping session via a new cc_session_id marker field, with deletion-provenance logging, cross-session fixture tests, and a doc sync.

summary: Planned the marker/session correlation fix: skill-base.sh's marker writer gains cc_session_id from $CLAUDE_CODE_SESSION_ID; subagent-postflight.sh and events-log-lifecycle.sh each enumerate all markers and act only on the correlated one (fail-safe: no match means no action, including for the global fallback and legacy markers); cap-reached deletion gets a distinct log label; test-subagent-postflight-marker.sh gains cross-session, cap-deletion, legacy-marker, and events-hook cases; postflight-control.md is synced. Resolved the research's open question in favor of mirrored per-hook logic over a shared helper, and flagged one edit target (postflight-control.md) beyond the task's binding five-file list, isolated in its own droppable final phase.
